title: vicia sativa subsp. cuneata
intro: Vicia sativa subsp. cuneata, commonly known as narrow-leaved vetch, is a subspecies of the vetch plant, which belongs to the pea family (Fabaceae). It is a perennial herb with a long history of traditional use, valued for its potential health benefits. Narrow-leaved vetch is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health.
